dreamingSettings.title: Dreams
dreamingSettings.subtitle: Inspect and maintain the background memory promotion sweep.
dreamingSettings.configTabHint: Tune the dreaming switch, global schedule, and Light / Deep / REM phase parameters.
dreamingSettings.runtimeTabHint: Review effective schedules, promotion lock, short-term recall store, and latest run output.
dreamingSettings.insightsTabHint: Preview promotion candidates and inspect phase audit logs.
dreamingSettings.maintenanceTabHint: Reset the short-term store or clear a stuck promotion lock; MEMORY.md is not edited.
dreamingSettings.runNowHint: Trigger the managed cron job immediately.
dreamingSettings.configHint: Edits agents.defaults.memory.dreaming and writes back to the gateway config file.
dreamingSettings.configPhaseDeepHint: Full promotion sweep with scoring and time decay (daily at 3 AM).
dreamingSettings.configPhaseRemHint: Cross-entry pattern clustering and dream diary (weekly on Sunday 5 AM).
dreamingSettings.previewHint: Shows the top candidates after rehydration, contamination filtering, and marker/hash dedupe checks. No files are written.
dreamingSettings.runtimeHint: Read-only: effective settings from the gateway, the recall store, and the latest sweep output.
dreamingSettings.statusHint: This reads the store under your configured workspace (memory/.dreams).
dreamingSettings.lastRunHint: memory/.dreams/last-run.json: timing, deep gate config snapshot, ranked/applied counts, and skip reasons. Raw JSON is below for debugging.
dreamingSettings.eventsHint: Audit trail of dreaming phase runs (memory/.dreams/events.jsonl).
dreamingSettings.maintenanceHint: These actions only affect the store/lock files. They do not edit MEMORY.md.
dreamingSettings.confirmResetStore: Reset the dreaming store? This clears short-term recall signals.
dreamingSettings.confirmClearLock: Clear the promotion lock file? Only do this if a sweep got stuck.

systemSettings.title: System permissions
systemSettings.desktopOnlyBody: System integration is available in the xopc Electron app. In the browser, use your OS settings instead.

toggles.openAtLoginDesc: Start xopc when you sign in to this user account.
toggles.keepAwakeDesc: While enabled, the app requests that the system stay awake (agent work may not be interrupted by idle sleep).
toggles.notifyDesktopDesc: Show native notifications when the app is in the background (updates, toasts, and agent errors).
toggles.notifySoundDesc: Play a short sound with each desktop notification.

systemSettings.permissionsHint: Status is best-effort. After changing system settings, refresh or revisit this page.
systemSettings.permissionsHintDarwin: macOS privacy (TCC) and media status are best-effort. Use Refresh after you change System Settings.
systemSettings.permissionsHintDevDarwin: Development builds (electron:dev) appear as Electron in System Settings, not xopc. Test permissions with a packaged .app for accurate naming.
systemSettings.permissionsHintWin: On Windows, microphone and (where reported) screen access follow system-wide toggles. Each link opens a relevant page in the Settings app.
systemSettings.permissionsHintLinux: Linux does not report these states here. We try to open your desktop’s Settings; otherwise a documentation page opens. Grant access in your distro, Flatpak, or portal as needed.
systemSettings.openSettingsFailed: Could not open system settings. Find the matching page manually.

permFeedback.openedSettings: Opened Microphone in System Settings — enable xopc, then tap Refresh status.
permFeedback.denied: Microphone access is denied. Enable xopc in System Settings.
permFeedback.rendererDenied: The app could not access the microphone. Check OS privacy settings.
permFeedback.prompted: If a system prompt appears, allow microphone access.

screenFeedback.openedSettings: Opened Screen Recording in System Settings — enable xopc, then tap Refresh status.
screenFeedback.denied: Screen recording is denied. Enable xopc in System Settings.
screenFeedback.prompted: If a system prompt appears, allow screen recording for xopc.

accessibilityFeedback.openedSettings: Opened Accessibility in System Settings — enable xopc, then tap Refresh status.
accessibilityFeedback.denied: Accessibility is not granted. Enable xopc in System Settings.

notificationsFeedback.openedSettings: Opened Notifications in System Settings — enable xopc, then tap Refresh status.
notificationsFeedback.denied: Notification permission was denied. Enable xopc in System Settings.
notificationsFeedback.prompted: If a system prompt appears, allow notifications for xopc.
notificationsFeedback.default: Notification permission was not granted. Try again or enable it in System Settings.
notificationsFeedback.unsupported: System notifications are not supported in this environment.

desktopNotify.testBody: You will see alerts here when xopc is in the background.
desktopNotify.testShown: Test notification sent. Allow notifications in System Settings if you did not see it.
desktopNotify.denied: Notification permission was denied. Enable notifications for xopc, then try again.

fullDisk.darwin: macOS does not report this until access is attempted. Grant Full Disk Access if workspace reads fail.
fullDisk.win32: Windows does not report this here. Open Storage settings if file access fails.
fullDisk.linux: Grant file access in your distro, Flatpak, or desktop portal if reads fail.

screen.darwin: Grant Screen Recording for xopc if screen capture tools fail.
screen.win32: Enable screen capture for desktop apps in Settings if capture fails.
screen.linux: Use your desktop portal or compositor settings if screen capture fails.

microphone.darwin: Use Request access or open Microphone settings if voice input fails.
microphone.win32: Use Request access or open Microphone privacy settings if voice input fails.
microphone.linux: Grant microphone access in your desktop or Flatpak settings if voice input fails.

accessibility.darwin: Required for global shortcuts. Use Request access, then enable xopc under Accessibility.
accessibility.win32: Open Accessibility settings if global shortcuts or integrations fail.
accessibility.linux: Grant accessibility permissions in your desktop environment if shortcuts fail.

automation.darwin: Grant Automation (Apple Events) if controlling other apps fails.
automation.win32: Configure default apps and automation in Windows Settings if integrations fail.
automation.linux: Use desktop portal or session settings for app integration if automation fails.

notifications.darwin: Use Request access, then allow notifications for xopc in System Settings.
notifications.win32: Use Request access, then allow notifications for xopc in Settings.
notifications.linux: Allow notifications in your desktop environment or Flatpak permissions.

location.darwin: Grant Location Services for xopc if location features fail.
location.win32: Enable location for desktop apps in Settings if location features fail.
location.linux: Grant location in your desktop portal if location features fail.

appManagement.title: App management
appManagement.devOnlyBody: Clear data and uninstall are only available in the packaged desktop app. Paths below are for reference.
appManagement.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the path and copy manually.
appManagement.cliDataWarning: Separate CLI data was found at ~/.xopc. Clearing local data here does not remove it.
appManagement.pendingUpdateBlocked: Finish or cancel the pending update before clearing data or uninstalling.
appManagement.clearDataDesc: Remove config, sessions, workspace, and caches. The app will restart with default settings.
appManagement.clearDataConfirmDesc: This permanently deletes API keys, sessions, transcripts, and workspace files stored by the desktop app. This cannot be undone.
appManagement.clearDataConfirmCheckbox: I understand this cannot be undone
appManagement.clearDataConfirmHint: The clear button stays disabled until the phrase matches exactly.
appManagement.uninstallDescDarwin: Opens Finder with xopc selected, then quits the app. Drag xopc.app to the Trash to finish uninstalling.
appManagement.uninstallDescWin: Opens the Windows uninstall wizard and quits xopc.
appManagement.uninstallDescLinuxAppImage: Opens the folder containing the AppImage, then quits xopc. Delete the AppImage file to uninstall.
appManagement.uninstallDescLinuxDeb: Quits xopc and opens the install folder. Remove the package with: sudo dpkg -r {{package}} (or use your distro software center).
appManagement.uninstallDescLinuxUnknown: Opens the install location, then quits xopc. Remove the app binary or package using your distro tools.
appManagement.removeUserDataCheckbox: Also clear local data before uninstalling

errors.pendingUpdate: A downloaded update is waiting to install. Restart to update or wait before uninstalling.
errors.uninstallerNotFound: Could not find the uninstaller. Remove xopc from Settings → Apps → Installed apps.
errors.notPackaged: This action is not available in development mode. Use the packaged desktop app.
errors.generic: Operation failed. Try again or use your system settings to uninstall.

imageModelsSettings.title: Images
imageModelsSettings.subtitle: Vision (understanding) and image-generation defaults, runtime options, and registered image providers.
imageModelsSettings.crossLinkHint: Primary chat model and sampling are on the Chat tab; text model fallbacks are on the Models tab (same group). This page and Agent defaults together edit vision (understanding) and image-generation fields in agents.defaults.
imageModelsSettings.timeoutHint: Hard cap for one generation attempt; leave empty for the gateway default (120000 ms).
imageModelsSettings.autoFallbackHint: After the primary chain fails, sweep every other configured provider before giving up.
imageModelsSettings.credentialsIntro: Set API keys and optional endpoints here. Values are written to config as providers.<id> (same as environment variables). Keys are never returned in full from the gateway.
imageModelsSettings.regionHint: DashScope: pick a region on its card to set region and the official image endpoint (Custom lets you type both).
imageModelsSettings.endpointPresetsHint: When a card shows endpoint or cluster presets, pick one or use Custom — values are saved as providers.<id>.baseUrl.
imageModelsSettings.imageModelsLinkTitle: Open Images settings for all providers
imageModelsSettings.imageBaseUrlPresetHint: Filled from the region preset; switch to “Custom” to edit.
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyMaskedHelp: Saved keys are hidden. Click the eye to load the key from your config file (providers.<id>.apiKey only — not from environment variables).
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyNotInConfigFile: No API key in the config file for this provider (it may come only from an environment variable).
imageModelsSettings.apiKeyRevealFailed: Could not load key from the gateway.
imageModelsSettings.minimaxClusterHint: MiniMax chooses China vs international by hostname, not a separate region code. The gateway stores that host as providers.minimax.baseUrl (what the runtime reads). DashScope uses providers.dashscope.region plus an image endpoint URL.
imageModelsSettings.falQueueBaseHint: Fal image calls are rooted at a queue URL (default `https://queue.fal.run`). This maps to `providers.fal.baseUrl`.

extensionImageGen.banner: API keys and endpoints are stored globally as providers.<id> (same as Settings → Images). Use either page — they stay in sync.

extensionSttMedia.banner: STT credentials are stored in tools.media.audio.providers.<id> (same as Settings → Voice). Use either page — they stay in sync.
extensionSttMedia.credentialsHint: Edits tools.media.audio.providers.{providerId} and enables STT when you save.

appearanceSettings.subtitle: Language, appearance, and text size for daily use. Stored in this browser only.
appearanceSettings.themeDescription: Light, dark, or follow your system setting.
appearanceSettings.fontScaleDescription: Adjust text size in chat and reading areas.
appearanceSettings.developerGroupDescription: Affects how tool-call results are displayed in chat.
appearanceSettings.showRawToolDataDescription: Reveal raw JSON input and output inside tool-call steps to help diagnose issues.

keyboardShortcutsSettings.subtitle: All keyboard shortcuts available in the app.

mcpSettings.title: External tools (MCP)
mcpSettings.subtitle: Configure outbound MCP servers (stdio or HTTP) for embedded agent runs. Disable all MCP tools with tools.disable: ["bundle-mcp"] on an agent.
mcpSettings.globalHint: Session idle TTL controls when unused MCP client runtimes are evicted (0 = never).
mcpSettings.idleTtlHint: Default is 10 minutes when unset. Set 0 to disable idle eviction.
mcpSettings.serversHint: Each server id becomes the prefix in tool names (server__tool). Extension .mcp.json files merge in automatically.
mcpSettings.envHint: Values may reference ${ENV_VAR}. Dangerous host env keys are filtered at startup.
mcpSettings.headersHint: Bearer tokens and custom headers for remote MCP servers.
mcpSettings.pasteHeadersFailed: Could not parse headers. Paste a JSON object or lines like "Authorization: Bearer token".
mcpSettings.timeoutHint: Connection, tool list, and tool call timeout in seconds (1–600). Leave empty for the default (30 s).
mcpSettings.toolsEmpty: No tools returned from this server.
mcpSettings.disableHint: To block MCP tools for an agent, add bundle-mcp to tools.disable on Agent defaults or a specific agent.
